blocks.raw: <Tip>**Memory aid:** Light-frame 1.45, masonry 2.90. Think "light is half" — stud threshold is exactly half the masonry threshold (1.45 = 2.90/2). These convert from 100 plf and 200 plf. Cavity walls: "51 to 114" — remember the range by rounding (50–100 ≈ 51–114).</Tip>
